patthana18.22:1.1: sārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:2.1: sārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, anārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, sārammaṇa na hetuñca anārammaṇaṃ na hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:3.1: no cittaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na no citto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:4.1: cittaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no citto na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:5.1: cetasikaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cetasiko na hetudhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:6.1: cetasikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na acetasiko na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:7.1: cittasampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittasampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:9.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittasaṃsaṭṭho na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:11.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasamuṭṭhāno na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:13.1: cittasahabhuṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasahabhū na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:15.1: cittānuparivattiṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittānuparivatti na hetudhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:17.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ samuṭṭhāno na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:19.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:21.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivatti na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.22:23.1: bāhiraṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bāhiro na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:25.1: hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhattiko na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. no upādā hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na no upādā na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:26.1: upādā na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no upādā na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:27.1: upādinnaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.22:28.1: anupādinnaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ hetuyā cattāri,
patthana18.22:29.1: upādinnaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinno na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.22:30.1: anupādinnaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ. hetuyā dve.
